csv_project_name: AE for Bozeman WTP Chemical Storage Tanks Replacement Ph 1
csv_scope_of_work: City of Bozeman (City) is seeking proposals from firms to provide professional engineering services to design, bid, and oversee construction of improvements to the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) chemical storage systems. The project will include replacement or relining of select existing chemical storage tanks and appurtenances, non-destructive condition assessment of all other existing tanks to determine remaining useful life, and preparation of complete bid documents suitable for public bidding under a design-bid-build delivery method.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Underground Tank Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics

- Utility infrastructure project focused on water treatment plant chemical storage tanks, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, tower, or complex building.
- Includes structural engineering, but the structural scope appears limited to tanks and appurtenances.
- Primarily replacement, relining, and condition assessment rather than a new architecturally demanding structure.
- Multidisciplinary design scope offers some engineering relevance, but overall fit with sbp core profile is low.
